thesis: The page is one gutter run hung by Quarter-Inch: a copper line that falls a measured quarter inch every ten feet of scroll, and each section is a fitting bolted onto it, until the water reaches the splash block in the footer.

signature.name: Pitch Run
signature.summary: A 3px copper gutter run with 10-ft tick marks and a cumulative fall readout (0 to 2 1/4 in) that falls a measured pitch down the page. Hero: the diagonal split edge is the run, meeting the real gutter in the photo, and a copper drop rolls it on load; story: six fittings (end cap, hanger, seam, outlet, elbow, splash block) on a falling run, the drop rolls fitting to fitting; services hang on hanger brackets under the run; reviews and sample-price rows carry ft-mark stamps and trough profiles; tools draw the fall over the typed run; footer: the run turns into a downspout and elbow and the drop lands on a splash block where contact and ZIP sit.

palette.family: Magnolia + River Mud + Downspout Copper + Chalk-Line Blue

layoutMoves: diagonal split hero whose slanted photo edge follows the photo's own gutter line
fixed 64px left margin column carrying the fall/length readout at >=1100px
services hung under a horizontal run on hanger brackets, each card a few px lower
pinned horizontal fittings story with a rolling drop
footer built as a downspout and splash block holding contact and ZIP

motion.intro: chalk-line snap: copper run draws to the photo seam, photo unclips along the slant, one drop rolls and parks (<=1.1s, skippable)
stories: roll: the drop rolls fitting to fitting through six process steps (pinned, scrubbed)
count + draw: margin fall readout counts in 1/4 in steps; footer downspout draws and the drop lands on the splash block
motion.hover: hanger strap: a copper underline that drops in at a slight pitch, scaleX 0 to 1 from left, 200ms
